title: AliasesFile
description:
`aliases.yaml`: the ids an earlier version of the pack used and the ids that replaced them,
so a flight saved with that version keeps its ticks, blanks, options and panel state when
the pack is updated (decision 0028).

Alias.description: An old saved id and what replaced it. Lets saved progress carry over.

from.description:
The old id, as an earlier version of the pack saved it. Each old id is listed once per
kind.

kind.description: What kind of id it renames, which says what `from` and `to` are.

to.description: The id that replaced it, which must exist in this version of the pack.

AliasKind.description: What an alias renames. Covers everything the previous release saved.

oneOf.description: A value typed into a blank. `to` is `<step-id>#<n>`, counting blanks from 0.
A saved flight value. `to` is one of the pack's flight fields.
